messages:
maya: Heads-up — bank opened chargeback CB-1972001111 for CloudSynth transaction tx_0x9c7b2a ($18,720.00). Cardholder (NordTech) says duplicate invoice / unauthorized. MCC returned by acquirer: 4814 (telecom) — weird. Putting payment on hold.
billing-bot: Automated: Chargeback CB-1972001111 created · merchant: CloudSynth (mch_849) · hold applied to payout · evidence request sent to merchant contact on file · deadline to respond: 5 days
frank: Can you paste the txn meta? amount, auth_time, acquirer ref, last4?
maya: Sure —
```
transaction_id: tx_0x9c7b2a
amount: 18720.00
currency: USD
auth_time: 2026-03-20T14:12:03Z
acquirer_ref: ACQ-77a2d
card_last4: 4321
merchant_id: mch_849
MCC: 4814
```
isaac: MCC 4814 for CloudSynth looks off. Could be a gateway mapping bug. We need merchant evidence: invoice, signed SOW or PO, delivery/provisioning logs, account activity proofs. If CloudSynth can show customer IPs or admin login that match provisioning, that helps.
sarah: Also need the contract/terms accepted by NordTech. If it's an enterprise, a PO or signed SOW is best. If merchant only has self-serve TOS, we can still submit but weaker.
maya: CloudSynth uploaded a screenshot of their billing dashboard and an invoice PDF to the support case (link: https://redwood-internal/s3/evidence/mch_849/tx_0x9c7b2a/invoice.pdf). They claim license activated on 2026-03-20. No signed SOW yet.
frank: OK. Can CloudSynth provide: 1) the invoice with matching amount and invoice id, 2) provisioning log (timestamp + IP), 3) any onboarding emails with NordTech contact?
isaac: Add this checklist to the dispute submission. Minimal packet we submit to bank:
```
- Merchant invoice (PDF)
- Merchant business terms + customer acceptance proof
- Provisioning/logs showing service activation (timestamps, IPs)
- Any sales email/PO from customer
- Screenshot of merchant portal (signed, with timezone)
```
maya: They also sent a CSV of provisioning events. One line shows activation at 2026-03-20T14:11:49Z from IP 198.51.100.23.
sarah: Save copies to the legal folder and mark sensitive. If no PO, legal will prepare a narrative to attach.
billing-bot: Evidence uploaded to dispute CB-1972001111 by maya: invoice.pdf, provisioning.csv, portal_screenshot.png · status: evidence_pending_review
frank: I'll validate invoice amount/ids and confirm timestamps line up with auth_time. If everything matches we can build representment packet. ETA EOD today.
isaac: If gateway mapping is wrong (MCC), we should flag ops to check mapping — but doesn't block representment.
maya: Noted. CloudSynth asked if we can fast-track submission — they're nervous about reserve hit. I'll tell them we're on it.
sarah: If merchant can't provide PO, let’s document business process evidence clearly. I can draft the narrative.
frank: Good. Keeping hold for now. If we need anything else I'll ping. :thumbsup:
